definitions.ask: Should ordinary agent prompt/reply text also hint `plan:` refs as whole tokens resolved on pick?

choices.label: Marker sits before `plan:` in all agent bodies and opens the plan; may regen a hint golden
Only clan/session text changes; agent bodies keep splitting `plan:` refs into dead paths

definitions.why: Same defect class and mechanism, with no added render-path cost

definitions.ask: Should a missing archived-prompt hint be retried in the project's agents sidecar on pick?

choices.label: Summary Prompt row opens even before clan enrichment lands; one off-thread stat on a miss
Prompt row stays dead until enrichment lands and hints are re-published

definitions.why: Second row of the same summary block, with the same race; tiny fix
